blocks.text: Super is usually the Windows/logo key. These are the managed defaults; locally changed Labwc bindings take precedence.

items: Alt+Tab / Alt+Shift+Tab: next / previous window in the current workspace.
Super+L or Ctrl+L: lock the desktop.
Ctrl+K: global search; type a phrase, then press Enter.
Alt+Left / Alt+Right: back / forward. Alt+Home: home.
Ctrl+F: find in the current article; Enter advances; Escape closes finding.
Ctrl+D: bookmark a guide. Ctrl++ / Ctrl+-: adjust reading size.
Tab / Shift+Tab: move between controls and links. Enter or Space: activate.
Ctrl+C: copy selected article text or code. F1: shortcuts. Ctrl+Q: close Help.

blocks.text: Labwc reads ~/.config/labwc/rc.xml. Make a private backup before manual editing. Keep well-formed XML and use the existing Reconfigure menu action after a deliberate change. If a shortcut conflicts inside an application, use the desktop menu instead.
